verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a zero-trust network connectivity and VPN platform. Turning plain-language requests into shell commands is a feature of AI terminals or assistants, so this story's axis falls outside Tailscale's product category. The pack does show adjacent AI features: a Tailscale skill that coding agents can use, and the Aperture CLI for running agents through a gateway. Neither shows Tailscale itself generating shell commands from natural language, so the exception for a wrong-axis capability the product actually ships does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command
